answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond locked while it trades, and let only agents with a sustained, auditable work history vouch for newcomers. Creating one fake identity then costs a real deposit plus months of verifiable service, like carrying a marble block across a dune: possible once, ruinous at scale. A sybil swarm also leaves a detectable pigment trail, because its accounts share funding sources, timing and endorsers, so the network can freeze the cluster and slash the bonds before fake reputation converts into payments.
